user.title: Create a managed temporary user
user.description: This creates a dedicated non-admin Home Assistant user with a deny-by-default entity whitelist and a browser Dashboard guard. An empty whitelist grants no entity access. Only the Owner can reveal or change its password from the card.

data.local_only: Allow login from local network only

data_description.guest_dashboard_path: The guest is redirected to this local Dashboard path, for example /dashboard-mzuser. This is a browser guard, not a server-side page permission.
data_description.read_entities: The guest can see these entity states but cannot control them.
data_description.control_entities: The guest can see and control these entities. This selection overrides read-only when an entity appears in both lists.

error.invalid_dashboard_path: Enter a local absolute path such as /dashboard-mzuser, without an origin, query, fragment, spaces, dot segments, or //
error.username_exists: This Home Assistant username already exists

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Temporary Guest instance is supported

init.title: Temporary Guest schedule, Dashboard, and entity access
init.description: Changing either entity list immediately revokes the guest's sessions and applies a server-side deny-by-default policy. The Dashboard path changes on the guest's next navigation. Empty entity lists grant no entity access.

data_description.guest_dashboard_path: The guest is redirected to this local Dashboard path and its child paths. The change is picked up on the next navigation.
data_description.read_entities: The guest can see these entity states but cannot control them.
data_description.control_entities: The guest can see and control these entities. This selection overrides read-only when an entity appears in both lists.

error.invalid_dashboard_path: Enter a local absolute path such as /dashboard-mzuser, without an origin, query, fragment, spaces, dot segments, or //
